confidence_notes: Restaurant, cappuccino and draft-beer anchors use the May 2026 Koh Samui Numbeo averages. Cocktail and wine anchors are bounded estimates from local menus, calibrated against the local draft-beer price; accommodation anchors are holistic estimates with substantial season and beach-area uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Koh Samui is a Thai resort island; food and drink reflect tourist-island pricing, while lodging estimates use broad Thai island guesthouse and resort-town comparables.
